headlines.text: Rewind to 2022, when a new chapter began as Jonathan Gresham vs. Dalton Castle fought for the brand-new ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.56. The very first Ring of Honor World Championship match to air on AEW programming ? a respectful, tightly-worked title defense that ended in Gresham's signature Octopus submission.
Back on this day in 2020, Lance Archer arrived in AEW against Colt Cabana, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.45.

Back on this day in 2026, Willow Nightingale vs. Kamille went to battle over the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 3.83. Kamille was challenging for gold for the very first time. It was the 70th time the AEW TBS Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2022, when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW TNT Title as Sammy Guevara vs. Scorpio Sky battled it out, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 5.41 ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. A shocking heel turn ? Guevara stooped to a low blow to steal the title back from Sky, in front of a hometown Texas crowd that had been fully behind the returning champion.
On a Friday in 2022, back when Adam Page vs. Adam Cole fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title in a Texas Death Match, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.82 ? a match that delivered.
Back on this day in 2022, it was a welcome sight as Nyla Rose returned to the ring after just over 2 months away, appearing on Battle of the Belts.
